rules.title: Policy order on algorithmic rent-pricing software
rules.requirement: The City Council passed a policy order starting steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting with firms whose algorithmic or AI-driven models recommend rents. The city manager is to draft policy options or ordinance language and present it to the council later this term.
rules.citation: City Council policy order, June 2026 (no number given)
rules.status_basis: Policy order directs the city manager to draft policy options or ordinance language; no ordinance has been adopted yet.

coverage.summary: Would reach residential property management companies that use algorithmic rent-recommendation services.

rules.quoted_span: City council also unanimously passed a policy order initiating steps to ban residential property management companies from contracting companies that use algorithmic and AI-driven models to recommend what they should charge for rent.
